title: conditional-reanalysis-assigned-var-pollution (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: The converter receives the original string before assignment changes the variable to Item|null; a null or invalid result throws.

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics. Constant-condition diagnostics measure broad behavior, not a recommendation that every redundancy deserves a product warning. Measured with PHP 8.3.35, PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.0 and Mago 1.57.0. phpstan agrees with the scoped expectation; psalm agrees with the scoped expectation; mago false_positive: unexpected diagnostic(s): invalid-argument@11, possibly-null-argument@11.
